title: Salt Life | KEY.co
description_expanded: - Blue Mountain Beach is a coastal community that rests between Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach State Park and is known for its tranquility, many restaurants, and family atmosphere. The natural beauty of the sugar sand beaches, walking, biking trails and adventure await you. Spend your mornings grabbing coffee and pastries from Blue Mountain Bakery and evenings strolling to dinner at Blue Mabel Restaurant or Red Fish Taco. Don't forget to grab dessert, or better yet, don't wait for dessert! Stop by Blue Mountain Beach Creamery after your bike ride or day at the beach to find out why so many argue that it's the best ice cream in town. Lakeside neighborhood is located adjacent to the Redfish Village where you'll find charming specialty boutiques and dining. Nestled in the serene Lakeside neighborhood of Blue Mountain Beach, this charming coastal retreat offers a perfect blend of relaxation and convenience. With four well-appointed bedrooms and spacious living, dining, and kitchen areas, this home is designed for unwinding after sun-filled days on the sugar-white sands of the Gulf. The front and back porches invite you to lounge with your loved ones and reflect on the day’s adventures. Just a 10-minute walk from Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access, you’ll enjoy the tranquility of the area while staying close to restaurants, shops, and local favorites like Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Red Fish Taco. A golf cart and two adult bikes make it easy to explore this vibrant community at your own pace.
